blocks.text: The Land Transportation Office (LTO) issues a show cause order against a passenger bus driver and its operator following a fatal accident in Atimonan, Quezon, where a pedestrian was killed after being struck by the bus’s detached engine cover. —Photo from LTO MANILA, Philippines — The Land Transportation Office (LTO) has issued a show cause order against a passenger bus driver and its operator following an accident in Atimonan, Quezon, in which a pedestrian was killed after the engine cover struck the victim.
